overlapping_phenotypes: developmental delay, microcephaly, intellectual disability, and upper-limb malformations
discriminating_phenotype: dense, arched eyebrows with continuous synophrys, hirsutism/generalized hypertrichosis, and severe longitudinal terminal limb deficiency
discriminating_logic: CdLS displays dense, arched eyebrows with continuous synophrys, hirsutism/generalized hypertrichosis, and severe longitudinal terminal limb deficiency. STISS lacks generalized hypertrichosis and severe limb reduction, presenting instead with mild preaxial or distal digital variations.

overlapping_phenotypes: developmental delay, high arched palates, and digital variations
discriminating_phenotype: broad, angulated thumbs and persistent broad great halluces
discriminating_logic: RSTS uniquely presents with broad, angulated thumbs and persistent broad great halluces. Digital abnormalities in STISS are restricted to hypoplasia, preaxial polydactyly, or mild webbing/syndactyly without broad angulation.

overlapping_phenotypes: congenital heart defects accompanied by preaxial upper limb/thumb abnormalities
discriminating_logic: Holt-Oram is non-syndromic with respect to cognition (neurodevelopment is normal), whereas STISS manifests complete penetrance of cognitive delay and variable neurodevelopmental deficits.

overlapping_phenotypes: autosomal dominant neurodevelopmental delay, intellectual disability, behavioral anomalies, bulbous nasal tip, and thin upper lip vermilion
discriminating_phenotype: renal fusion anomalies (horseshoe kidney) and preaxial digital duplication/hypoplasia
discriminating_logic: Facial gestalts overlap extensively. Renal fusion anomalies (horseshoe kidney) and preaxial digital duplication/hypoplasia point preferentially to PSMD12, but standalone facial discrimination is unreliable.
